mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_notification_push_outbox (notification_id, payload_json, status, attempt_count, version, next_attempt_at, created_time, updated_time) values (#{notificationId}, #{payloadJson}, 'PENDING', 0, 0, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.sql: ((status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and next_attempt_at <= #{now}) or (status = 'SENDING' and updated_time <= #{staleBefore}))
mapper.select: select outbox_id, notification_id, payload_json, status, attempt_count, version, next_attempt_at, last_result, created_time, updated_time from sys_user_notification_push_outbox where order by outbox_id limit #{limit}
